bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses, clutches or fanny packs smaller than 16.5 cm x 11.5 cm (6.5" x 4.5") are allowed at TD Coliseum.
allowed: Small purses, clutches or fanny packs under 16.5 cm x 11.5 cm
bagPolicy.note: There is no bag check. A bag that does not meet the policy for medical or other reasons may be let in after x-ray inspection. The venue encourages fans not to bring any bag.

parking.note: There is no on-site parking at TD Coliseum, but upgraded parking can be purchased for the York Boulevard Parkade through the TD Coliseum Mobile App. Several nearby lots and garages are within walking distance, and arriving early is recommended.

rideshare.note: Use the Vine Street lot off James Street North for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Allow a short walk to the arena entrances.

concessions.note: TD Coliseum offers a variety of food and drink options ranging from quick-service concessions to luxury dining experiences. Highlights include local favorites and arena classics, premium dining with bespoke bars, and themed lounges like the TD Lounge and Vinyl Room. Special offerings feature Ontario cheese boards, Hamilton Brewery drafts, and Niagara wines.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair-accessible seating is in the last row of Sections 109, 110, 112, 113, and 114, and you can buy it online at Ticketmaster.ca. All washrooms and amenities are fully accessible. For other needs, fill out the Fan Services form and the team will contact you.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is at Bay Street and York Boulevard and opens on event days three hours before the show. Will call opens two hours before showtime. Bring valid photo ID and the purchase credit card.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors typically open 1 hour before each event, so check the event page for your show's exact time. If you need accessible seating, enter through Gate 4 on York Blvd.
